'''Fahren Jaj''', also known as '''the Laughing Lord''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] who was part of the [[Infernal Council]], a group of Sith enslaved by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Soa]] and imprisoned with him in the [[Eternity Vault]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="Eternity Vault" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Fahren Jaj, the Laughing Lord, first appeared as part of the Operation "The Eternity Vault" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]].<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
